reply_body: Samajh gaya — aapke paas app abhi bhi free version dikha raha hai jabki aapne payment kiya tha. Humare system mein woh payment abhi complete nahi dikh raha, isliye plan switch nahi hua hai. Screenshot zaroor bhej dijiye, usse match karne mein aasani hogi. Yeh humari billing team ke paas ja raha hai taaki aapke account ke records check kiye ja sakein, aur update aapko jaldi mil jayega.
summary: User says payment went through but plan still shows free version; latest attempt recorded as incomplete on our side.
